newsitem.title: MEXICO: Chief of Mexico's development bank Nafin resigns.
newsitem.headline: Chief of Mexico's development bank Nafin resigns.

text.p: Gilberto Borja Navarrete, director general of the development bank Nacional Financiera (Nafin), has resigned, the office of Mexican President Ernesto Zedillo said.
Borja Navarrete is stepping down because of health reasons, Zedillo's office said in a statement.
"This decision was taken by Borja Navarrete on a medical recommendation," the statement said.
However, Borja Navarrete agreed to continue working with Zedillo as an adviser for special projects, Zedillo's office said.
Borja Navarrete had been in charge of Nafin since Zedillo took office in December, 1994.

Nafin is the Mexican government's main development bank, offering loans to Mexican companies that are executed through commercial banks. Mexico's other development bank is Bancomext, which concentrates on lending to companies for export.
